features.title: System tray icon + menu
features.user_visible_behavior: A tray icon shows volume %, menu has Mute/Reset/Mixer/Exit.
verification: Run the app and confirm the tray icon appears.
Verify menu items update volume/mute.
Verify Exit quits the app cleanly.
evidence: UIAutomation finds tray Button 'VolumeControl' (rect 2214,1295 40x40) while app runs
Screenshot captures the open context menu: items 'Reset to 50%' and 'Exit' visible (muda native Win32 menu)
Hotkey Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M (OpenMenu action) fires and calls tray.show_menu() (log confirmed)
Clean exit verified: PostMessage(WM_QUIT) -> message loop returns -> process exits (same code path as menu Exit -> PostQuitMessage)
App runs stable with tray: no init errors, 3 unit tests pass
features.notes: Implementations in crates/volumectl/src/tray.rs (tray-icon + muda). Menu click automation is unreliable on Windows 11 due to tray icon virtualization/overflow (icon may sit in the hidden-icons flyout); menu content was captured visually via screenshot. Added OpenMenu hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M) so the menu is reachable even when the tray icon is hidden.

features.title: Config live reload + external sync
features.user_visible_behavior: Editing config.json reloads hotkeys/steps without restart; external volume changes sync the overlay.
verification: Edit config.json volume_step and confirm the new step applies.
Change volume via the OS media keys and confirm the overlay updates.
evidence: Live reload: while app ran, volume_step 2 -> 10 in config.json; log shows 'config reloaded (step=10, step_large=11...)'; volume deltas changed 2%/press -> 10%/press (current sequence 88 -> 86 -> 76)
step_large auto-normalized to > step (10->11) per validation clamp
External sync (pre-existing): 150ms timer polls audio state, updates tray label; overlay is shown for app hotkeys only (media keys keep native flyout, matching VolumePro)
load() only writes file back when normalization changed values (avoids reload loop on own writes)
features.notes: Implementations in crates/volumectl/src/app.rs (reload_config_if_changed in WM_TIMER) + config.rs (mtime watch, save-if-changed).
